domain_notes: Explicitly labelled reduced criterion, used for software regression and parameter continuation. Requires: external travel time t_ext between mouths, wormhole traversal time t_wh, accumulated mouth time shift Delta t, all in one declared synchronisation.
global_margin_note: margin = t_ext + t_wh - |Delta t|. Negative margin means the declared route closes to the past. This is an ARCHITECTURE-SPECIFIC reduced predicate under declared synchronisation and traversal assumptions, NOT a universal theorem for arbitrary dynamical wormholes. A production model must compute causal travel times from the full metric and the mouth worldlines.
title: M16 Time-shifted traversable wormhole (reduced route-closure model)
topology: two mouths with a nontrivial spacetime identification
